text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Suruhanja ya Koperasi
Malaysia (Tarikh Peletakhakan) 2017.

(2)  Perintah ini disifatkan telah mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 Januari 2008.

Tarikh peletakhakan

2. Menteri menetapkan 1 Januari 2008 sebagai tarikh peletakhakan bagi maksud
seksyen 5 Akta dan pada tarikh itu segala harta, hak dan liabiliti Kerajaan Malaysia
ke atas tanah  yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual hendaklah dipindahkan dan diletak hak
pada Suruhanjaya Koperasi Malaysia tanpa apa -apa pemindahhakan, penyerahhakan
atau pemindahan hakmilik.

MALAYSIA CO-OPERATIVE SOCIETIES COMMISSION ACT 2007

MALAYSIA CO-OPERATIVE SOCIETIES COMMISSION (VESTING DATE) ORDER 2017

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 5(1) of the
Malaysia Co-operative Societies Commission Act 2007 [ Act 665], the Minister makes the
following order:

Citation and commencement
1. (1) This order may be cited as the Malaysia Co -operative Societies
Commission (Vesting Date) Order 2017.

 (2) This Order is deemed to have come into operation on 1 January 2008.

Vesting date
2. The Minis ter appoints 1 January 2008 as the vesting date for the purposes of
section 5 of the Act and on such date all proper ties, rights and liabilities of the
Government of Malaysia on the land specified in the Schedule shall be transferred to and
be vested in the Malaysia Co-operative Societies Commission without any conveyance,
assignment or transfer.
